portable.description: Run dependency Python tests in the locked portable-tests image with no network access.

linux-native.description: Build and test the Linux product in the locked linux-build image on a matching native architecture: copy /src into /work, install CEF/Geist from the deps lock, configure+build with Ninja, run CTest under Xvfb, export logs. The router appends --target <linux64|linuxarm64> and sets ISLAND_TARGET.

macos-native.description: Native macOS build. Routed to the host toolchain; never containerized.

windows-native.description: Native Windows build. Routed to the host toolchain; never containerized.
